sql.excel.import.sqlId: select case when seq.last_value >= 9999 then setval('brs.proposal_excel_id_seq', 1000) else nextval('brs.proposal_excel_id_seq') end as prop_id from brs.proposal_excel_id_seq seq
sql.excel.import.validateProjectId: select p.project_name as customer_name, concat_ws(' ', c.street1, c.street2) street, c.city, s.state, c.postal_code, c.phone, c.email, (select lov.name from flow.list_of_value lov where lov.id = (select int_value from flow.contact_custom_field_value where contact_id = (select contact_id from flow.project where id = :projectId) and custom_field_group_assignment_id = 395)::integer) as source, trim(concat(users.first_name, ' ', users.last_name)) as deal_owner, (select numeric_value from flow.project_process_step_custom_field_value where project_process_step_id = (select id from flow.project_process_step where project_id = :projectId and process_step_id=3) and custom_field_group_assignment_id= 709) as epc_proposal_pricing, (select user_id from flow.user_position where id = (select user_position_id from flow.project_process_step where project_id = :projectId and process_step_id = 2) ) as deal_owner_id from flow.project p inner join flow.contact c on c.id = p.contact_id left join flow.company_state cs on cs.id = c.company_state_id left join flow.state s on s.id = cs.state_id left join flow.user users on users.id = p.created_by_id where p.id = :projectId
sql.excel.import.insert: insert into brs.proposal_log (proposal_date, source, proposal, proposal_nbr, project_id) values ( :proposalDate, :source, :proposal, :proposalId, :projectId) returning *
sql.excel.import.design.sqlId: select case when seq.last_value >= 9999 then setval('brs.design_nbr_seq', 1000) else nextval('brs.design_nbr_seq') end as design_id from brs.design_nbr_seq seq
sql.excel.import.design.insert: WITH t1 AS ( INSERT INTO brs.design_log (design_date, source, design, design_nbr, project_id, bom) VALUES (:designDate, :source, :design, nextval('brs.design_nbr_seq'), :projectId, :bom) RETURNING * ) SELECT t.*, t.design_nbr AS design_id FROM t1 t
sql.excel.import.loadProposal: select proposal from brs.proposal_log where project_id = :projectId and proposal_nbr = :proposalId order by proposal_date desc;
